messages:
incident-bot: ALERT: GPU memory pressure auto-pager fired for pool-west2a (PD-8271). Affected nodes: g-wn-03,g-wn-05. Severity: P1. Link: https://pagerduty.example/incidents/PD-8271
pagerduty: PagerDuty: Incident PD-8271 triggered and unacknowledged.
maria_oncall: ack PD-8271. I'm taking initial triage.
kevin_sre: seeing repeated cudaMalloc OOMs on g-wn-03. Sample logs:
```
[2026-03-17T02:11:05Z] nvml: GPU 0 cudaMalloc -> out of memory
model_runner: kv_cache_alloc 536870912 -> ENOMEM
[2026-03-17T02:11:07Z] kernel: cublas alloc failed
```
carla_eng: noteworthy: recent rollout of prefetcher v2.1 to pool-west2a. Reverting prefetch on that deployment.
carla_eng: kubectl -n inference rollout undo deploy/prefetcher --to-revision=3
maria_oncall: cordoned g-wn-05 and cordoned scheduling of new inference pods on g-wn-03 while we stabilize.
tina_support: received customer report from Acme Chat: "intermittent 503s and 2–5s latency spikes" — their traffic ~pto-150 rps to route 'chat-small'
kevin_sre: temporarily changed routing for route 'chat-small' -> route to fallback model 'gpt-small-quant' to reduce memory footprint.
maria_oncall: triggered autoscaler policy to add capacity +2 GPU nodes (policy: emergency-burst). New nodes requested.
monitoring-bot: New nodes provisioning started: nodepool-west2a-urgent scale +2. ETA ~4m
kevin_sre: observed drop in OOMs after revert and fallback routing; still seeing KV cache evictions on g-wn-03 at low rate.
carla_eng: increased kv cache eviction threshold and disabled prefetch for pool-west2a in config v0.9.2.
maria_oncall: notified SRE lead and product. Posted customer-facing note to status page draft.
tina_support: pinged Acme Chat with workaround (fallback routing) and ETA for follow-up.
kevin_sre: will keep PD acknowledged. If no new OOMs in 15m we'll mark incident as mitigated and monitor for regression.
incident-bot: PD-8271 acknowledged by maria_oncall at 4882461400. Monitoring window open for 60m. Autoclose if no new alerts.
monitoring-bot: alert rate has fallen from 18/min -> 2/min over last 6m.
maria_oncall: thanks team. moving to post-incident collection once stabilized. :thumbsup:
